title: 応用化学専門実験・演習B2
subtitle: Applied Chemistry Major Lab/Exercises B2
keywords: Chemical Engineering 2.High Pressure Gas 3.Powder 4.Reaction Engineering 5.Treatment of Environmental Pollutants
educationalGoal: Learn the correct clothing/protective equipment suitable for experiments, use experimental tools correctly, and conduct experiments safely. Learn the specific information for the experiments and conduct experiments on your own. Prepare a report describing the experimental method and results and submit it by the deadline. Acquire the ability to conduct experiments by verifying and reporting on material learned in courses and through experiments.
advice: Conduct experiments in chemical engineering. The objective of this experimental course is to acquire more knowledge than that learned in lectures and to gain skills in research, experimental methods, and reporting that are necessary to perform activities in Design Project III (4th year). If understanding experiments is difficult, you need to actively gain the understanding through reading, asking questions, and attending office hours, along with sufficient preparation and review of the experimental method and principles. Be sure to attend the guidance given for each experiment to learn about precautions, handling of experimental apparatus, safety training, and other important information. Experimental guidance Safety training Chemical Engineering High Pressure Gas Powder Reaction Engineering Treatment of Environmental Pollutants Examination and Self-evaluation
books: Textbooks: Ouyou Kagaku Kiso Jikken/enshu AB (Kanazawa Institute of Technology Publishing)
requiredKnowledge: Bring an A4 size experimental notebook, scientific calculator, and ruler. Experiments should be conducted after reviewing the course material, understanding the experimental theory, and preparing the materials for the experiments. If the progress of the experiment is delayed, class time will be extended until the experiment is completed, so keep some time free after the class on experiment days.

activityGoals.body: Wear appropriate clothing, understand the use of the equipment, handle reagents properly, and conduct safely.
Record experimental conditions and results accurately in the experimental notes.
Complete the experimental report using the prescribed format and explain it to others.
Describe observed phenomena and obtained data in experiments, based on principles of physics and chemistry.
Conduct the experiments on your own, according to the instructions.
Understand the fundamental principles of chemical engineering.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1. Use protective equipment and autonomously conduct experiments safely and competently. 2. Understand sufficiently the fundamental principles of chemical engineering, and conduct experimental operations accurately. 3. Understand sufficiently the fundamental principles and objectives of the experimental operation, summarize the experimental data obtained, and discuss the results. 4. Record experimental contents and results accurately. 5. Prepare a report using the prescribed format and explain it easily to others.
achievementLevels.standard: 1. Use protective equipment and conduct experiments safely. 2. Understand the fundamental principles of chemical engineering, and conduct experimental operations. 3. Understand the fundamental principles and objectives of the experimental operation, summarize the experimental data obtained, and utilize for discussion. 4. Record experimental contents and results. 5. Prepare a report using the prescribed format.

lessons.content: Guidance for physical chemistry experiment and safety training Safe handling of a high-pressure gas cylinder How to attach and remove a regulator
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Describe translational motion and classical mechanics. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Pulverization and specific surface area of powders Specific surface area determination methods and devices
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Prepare the vapor-liquid equilibrium curve of the binary mixture of ethanol and water. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Reaction engineering Calculation of activation energy by Arrhenius plot
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Understand the theoretical stage and operating line in the vapor-liquid equilibrium diagram. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.

lessons.content: Environmental chemical engineering Treatment of environmental pollutants using oxidation-reduction, coagulation-sedimentation, and activated carbon adsorption
lessons.assignments: Pre-Lab Assignment: Calculate the Reynolds number under various conditions. Assignment: Complete post-laboratory report.
